name: 165. Typesafe as a custom provider base (typesafe-custom-base)
description: A custom provider may use base_provider_type "typesafe". The profile declares typesafe_custom (base typesafe, its own key) and typesafe_custom_gated (base typesafe, allowed_requests without decisions). Before this change typesafe was not in SupportedBaseProviders, so both providers were refused at config load and every case here failed; the Typesafe provider also hard-coded its name, so a custom instance would have reported, looked up and selected keys as the standard typesafe provider, ignored allowed_requests, and the native /typesafe/v1/models listing kept the custom prefix. The cases pin: decisions are served by the custom provider and reported under its own name; the native systemone route reaches it through the model prefix; the native model listing returns bare names for it; and allowed_requests denies decisions with unsupported_operation instead of reaching the upstream or emulating.
